title: Connie N Probable NDE 6386
content: Birth of youngest child. Hospital staff appears aggravated to have to deal with an obstetric patient. Gas mask placed over my face and I immediately could not breathe. I kept gasping for air and trying to take the mask off my face. I felt like I was dying. The best description was of being forced through a passage that was too small. There was darkness on the other side like floating in outer space. I felt the presence of a loved one, my maternal grandfather who had passed years earlier. He spoke only French when he was alive and I only spoke English yet I fully understood communication with him. He asked me to follow him into the tunnel. Once entering the tunnel, we seem to float along at a very fast speed. At the end of the tunnel appeared a light. We went towards the light. When I arrived in the light there were others present who I immediately recognized, yet could not tell you who they were. They appeared to me as bright lights. They welcome me and pulled me into the larger white light. The white light I immediately knew as GOD: the SOURCE of all that is. The large light, along with the other lights and I became one. Complete and total feeling of love and happiness enveloped me. It is hard to describe how wonderful it was. The light communicated to me through ‘knowing-ness’ not with words. ’You must go back’ the light communicated to me. I began to beg and expressed N-O-O-O-, but immediately I turned into one cell and then two and quickly multiplied into numerous cells. I opened my eyes and was back in my body. My ex-husband was at my bedside and I tried to tell him what had happened to me. The TV was on in the room and I knew exactly what would be said on the TV before it was said. I tried to tell him what would be said next. I told him I had died and came back. He went speak with one of the nurses. They told him it was a response to the drugs they had given me. I knew this was not true. No one could convince me then, or now, that I did not cross over into the light and return. I had never heard or read of anyone having the same experience so I kept the information to myself; since those I attempt to share with appeared to not believe me. I returned to my church/Catholic and became a very active member: going to Mass daily when able. At random moments, I have since heard GOD speak to me. Not with words but a ‘knowing’.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described as being "forced through a passage that was too small" and then "float along at a very fast speed."

arrival.other_being_detail: Others were present as "bright lights" that were immediately recognized but not identifiable by name/role.

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness "like floating in outer space" on the other side of the initial passage; later a "larger white light."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: After being told "You must go back," she "turned into one cell and then two and quickly multiplied into numerous cells" and then opened her eyes back in her body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Gas mask placed over face; she "immediately could not breathe" and felt like she was dying.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Catholic (returned to church/Catholic after the experience).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial constricted passage; darkness like outer space; merging into the light; cell-multiplication imagery on return; later ongoing "knowing" communications.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Constricted passage/darkness preceded the tunnel; then light, beings, unity/merging, message to return, rapid return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Return described as transforming into cells ("one cell and then two... quickly multiplied"). Also reported knowing TV dialogue before it was spoken and later hearing God via "knowing".
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "forced through a passage that was too small"; "darkness... like floating in outer space"; "You must go back"; "The large light, along with the other lights and I became one."; "Not with words but a ‘knowing’."
